title: The website's gauge arc is hidden in print instead of pinned to the animation's end value
outcome: The website's gauge arc is hidden in print instead of pinned to the animation's end value
acceptance: In print the decorative gauge arc of the machine section is hidden by one rule, and no print rule or test repeats a number taken from the screen animation
The text and the caption that carry the gauge's meaning print legibly; a fresh-load print test covers it; the screen is unchanged
disposal_reason: Moot. The machine section landed as 5a02f2f with folios V to VIII left out of print by one rule, so the gauge arc is not printed and no print rule or test pins a value from the screen animation. The printable machine section is tracked by its own item.
